description: The line plot, titled “ChatGPT on Songs,” illustrates the relationship between “Answer Popularity” (x-axis) and three performance metrics: “Accuracy,” “Confidence,” and an unlabeled red line with square markers (y-axis, labeled “Values”). The x-axis, “Answer Popularity,” spans from 0 to 160 with tick marks at intervals of 20, using a linear scale. The y-axis, “Values,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, also on a linear scale. The blue line with circular markers, labeled “Accuracy,” begins at approximately 0.55 at Answer Popularity 10, dips to 0.48 at 20, rises sharply to 0.76 at 40, peaks at 0.88 near 90, and then stabilizes around 0.83–0.84 through 160. The green line with triangular markers, labeled “Confidence,” starts at 0.92 at 10, fluctuates slightly between 0.90 and 0.95 across the range, peaking at 0.98 near 100, and ends at 0.96 at 160. The red line with square markers begins at 0.64 at 10, dips to 0.58 at 20, rises to 0.82 at 40, peaks at 0.89 near 90, and settles at 0.87 by 160. All three lines show an initial rise with increasing popularity, with Confidence remaining consistently high and stable, while Accuracy and the red metric exhibit more pronounced growth and stabilization after an initial dip.
